    General Information about the 
University 
 
Thammasat University, the second oldest university in Thailand, was  
established in  1934. There are 27 faculties  which offer more than 290 
academic programs Presently, there are around 43,000 students, 80% of 
whom are undergraduate students.

University Features 
Thammasat University (TU) is well known for its impact on Thai history, 
especially the  change in politics in 1932. TU has continued to play an 
important role in Thai politics and history and embraces the philosophy of 
being a “University for the People”. Five former prime ministers  have 
been Thammasat graduates. Over time , Thammasat University  has 
grown academically through its world -class learning environment, 
quality graduates, and research. It is one of the top research universities 
in Thailand. The university continues to expand its educational services, 
research and international network of partnerships to serve as an 
education hub for Southeast Asia.  
 
 
 
 
Short description of the city 
Bangkok is one of the Top10 Best Cities to visit in the world. Tha Prachan is 
located in a historical area of Bangkok, right next to the national museum 
a n d a  5-minute walk to  the Grand Palace . Presently, there are four 
campuses (Tha Prachan / Rangsit / Pattaya / Lampang). The Rangsit 
Center, located in Pathumthani province,  is the largest campus in the 
region. All undergraduate programs w e r e relocated to t h e Rangsit 
Center in 2006 except international programs. It is the home of science, 
technology and medical programs.

Credit System 
Credits accumulated at TU are transferable to student’s home university as 
part of the requirements for graduation. However, it is the responsibility of 
individual students to check the subject's equivalencies  with their home 
university. 
 
An official academic transcript will be sent to the International Office of the 
student’s home institution by OIA approximately 8-12 weeks after the end of 
the final examination. OIA will mail the students' transcripts by post directly 
to student's home university. 
 
     Course Registration Condition 
Courses taken must be at the same level of study or lower than the current level 
of study at the home university. Exchange students are not allowed to take  
a course higher than the level of their study at their home university. 
Level of Studies for Exchange We accept both undergraduate and graduate students. 
 
Duration of Exchange Program 
An exchange student is not permitted to spend  more than two semesters 
during an exchange period at Thammasat University , as specified in the  
universities’ bilateral agreement. 
 
 
GPA Requirement 
The standard GPA requirement is 3 .0 on a 4.0 scale. However, in certain  
situations, many  programs are flexible and may  consider accepting 
students with a lower GPA than 3.0. Please contact the relevant faculty for 
further information and GPA requirement. 
 
Available Services 
  Student ID Card and Internet Access 
An international student identification card and internet access will be 
issued by the Faculty's coordinator about two weeks after the completion 
of the student’s registration. Wi-Fi internet access is available without extra 
charge for all students. 
 
Library 
Students have full library access and borrowing privileges, including the 
printing of 200  pages (up to 200 Baht/semester). Information on the TU 
Library can be obtained at http://library.tu.ac.th. 
 
Recreational Facilities 
Sports and Recreational facilities are available on campus . Some may 
charge a student rate. Students are recommended to carry their ID card when 
requesting the use of services.

Bus Services 
Tha Prachan  
There are buses (No.1-9E) operating between Tha Prachan and the Rangsit 
Center from 5 :00 am  – 9:45 pm . (schedule may change without prior 
notice). The bus station is near the front gate, opposite Sanam Luang Field.  
 
Rangsit  
Shuttle buses are freely available around the campus for all students. 
 
Bank 
Tha Prachan  
Krung Thai Bank is located on campus. 
Krung Thep Bank (Bangkok Bank) is located next to the Tha Prachan Gate. 
 
Rangsit  
Krung Thai, SCB, Krung Thep (Bangkok bank) and TTB are located on 
campus. Kasikorn Bank is located at the Asian Institute of Technology. 
 
Health Services 
Tha Prachan  
During working hours, the university offers free health care services to all 
students for general medical treatment . Mental health counsellor s  
(Clinical Psychologists) are also available.  Students are required to present 
their ID card. The health care services center is located on the ground floor 
of the student activity building . In the Tha Pra Chan area, there are two 
nearby hospitals: Siriraj Hospital and Chao Praya Hospital. 
 
Rangsit 
A medical service room is located on the 1st floor of the SC building. For serious 
injuries or accidents, the patient will be transferred to the Thammasat 
University Hospital. 
 
Bookstore 
Thammasat University operates  bookstores on both campuses  where local 
and international books, stationery,  and gift souvenirs are offered.

Deadlines

Note:  A late application may be considered if an explanation is provided

Application 
Procedure 
 
 
Areas of study available for 
exchange students 
Exchange students are welcome to enroll in most faculties.  Acceptance will 
be at the discretion of the individual faculty. 
 
Note:  As certain programs offer limited spaces and are competitive,  
an exchange student must be flexible  in enrolling  in alternative courses. 
              Course Offering https://oia.tu.ac.th/criteria-course/ 
 
 
               How to apply 
Nomination: Via online portal. The link will be provided to coordinators 
by email. 
Application: Nominated students will receive a link to the application. 
 
The application contains important dates and deadlines which are subject to 
change. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
                 Requirements 
Qualified international students are invited to apply for a TU exchange 
program by being nominated by partner universities . The eligibility  
requirements are: 
1. Enrolled as a degree student at applicant’s  home university; 
2. Have completed at least one academic year of study at applicant’s home 
university; 
3. Nominated by applicant’s home university (an official 
coordinator’s email address from applicant’s  home 
university is required); 
4. Have good academic standing with a GPA not lower than 3.0 (on a 
4.0 scale) or equivalent. If lower, please discuss with OIA. 
5. A good command of English. Each faculty/program has different 
criteria of TOEFL and IELTS  scores. See the attached criteria 
sheet for more details. 
6. Exchange students must enroll in at least  3 courses (equivalent to 9 
credits) in one discipline at Thammasat University in order to be 
recognized as the major and must remain in these three courses 
throughout their study period at Thammasat University. The 
maximum credits exchange students are allowed to enroll in are 18

Application material 
- Certificate of Health (designated form) 
- Academic Transcript (must be in English or with accompanying 
translation) 
- Recommendation letter(s) (if required by the host program) 
- A valid TOEFL/IELTS score sheet 
- A copy of passport (must be valid for at least 6 months after completing 
the exchange program) 
- A digital photo, complying with passport ID requirements  
- Proof of medical insurance which covers the entire period of stay in 
Thailand. The insurance can be either local or international.

How to travel to Thammasat 
University from the airports 
 
Since the university's two campuses are located close  to the center  of 
Bangkok (Tha Pra Chan) and the well-known suburb of Rangsit, students 
can easily travel from Suvarnnabhumi or Don M ueang airports to the 
university by bus, airport rail link, taxi or hotel limousine.  
 
Taxi: 
Students with a lot of luggage are advised to take a taxi directly from the 
airport to the campus . Taxi fares can only be paid in cash  (Thai Baht). 
The university has 2 campuses so students should clearly indicate to  the 
driver to which campus they are heading –  Tha Pra Chan or Rangsit. 
Others: 
From Suvarnabhumi Airport, take the Airport Rail Link (ARL) to 
Makkasan Station. Transfer there to the MRT Subway at Phetchaburi 
Station and continue to Sanam Chai Station, which is the nearest station 
to TU’s Tha Prachan campus 
 
 
Orientation program 
 
The Orientation Program will normally be held one week before the 
start of each semester.

Medical Insurance 
 
 
 
 
Insurance 
Students are required to purchase a medical insurance plan from their 
home country which covers the following areas: 
1. Health and Accident 
2. Permanent and Partial Disability 
3. Repatriation 
4. Death 
 
 
Accommodation 
 
 
 
 
 
Accommodation 
The Office of International Affairs  does not manage the accommodation 
reservation. 
Students are responsible for managing and booking their own 
preferred living arrangements.  
However, we provide information and a list of accommodations to help 
students. Please follow the link below:  
https://oia.tu.ac.th/accommodation-page/ 
** Private apartments: students should contact the private 
apartment directly as soon as their placement in a university 
program is confirmed**

VISA Information 
 
 
 
Immigration Procedure 
Upon receiving an acceptance letter from the OIA Thammasat, students are 
advised to visit https://www.thaievisa.go.th/ and complete the necessary visa 
application procedures before their departure for Thailand . Please note that 
the processing time for visa issuance may vary depending on the embassy 
or consulate . We strongly recommend that students plan their visa 
application well in advance.

Please also note that all non -Thai nationals entering the Kingdom of 
Thailand are required to submit  a Thailand Digital Arrival Card  online 3 
days prior to entry . More information can be found at : 
https://tdac.immigration.go.th/manual/en/index.html 
 
 
 
 
Student VISA Application 
Procedure 
International students must  have a valid travel document (passport with 
entry visa) to enter Thailand. 
International passports must be valid for a minimum of 6 months beyond the 
expected date of exit from the country. 
A visa must be obtained BEFORE you enter Thailand by self – 
representation at the visa issuing office. For Immigration clearance, you are 
required to produce the Immigration approval letter upon arrival.
